statements.statement: This member has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
This member has atherosclerotic heart disease
The member is presenting with recurrent episodes of palpitations
The member is presenting with intermittent lightheadedness
Mobile cardiac telemetry CPT 93229 was billed
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
